issues.quote: Allah will admit him into Paradise with the deeds he had done
issues.why: The Arabic 'على ما كان من العمل' means 'whatever his deeds may have been' (i.e., regardless of his deeds), not 'with the deeds he had done', which reverses the intended meaning of unconditional admission despite deeds.

issues.quote: Аллоҳ уни қилган амали билан жаннатга киритади
issues.why: The Arabic 'على ما كان من العمل' conveys 'regardless of/whatever his deeds were' (emphasizing entry to Paradise despite the state of his deeds), but the Uzbek 'билан' (with/by means of) renders it as entry being accomplished through his deeds, reversing the intended meaning.
Бу «қилган амали билан» дегани. Арабчадаги «على ما كان من العمل» эса амали қандай бўлган бўлса ҳам, жаннатга киритилишини билдиради; таржимада шу маъно берилмаган.

Arabic 'على ما كان من العمل' means 'whatever/regardless of the deeds he had done', implying admission despite one's deeds; the Tajik 'бо он амале ки дошт' ('with the deed he had') reverses this nuance to suggest deeds as the means of admission.
